What we look for

We’re drawn to teams with real founder signal: insight, speed, and a relationship-first mindset. We care about clarity, not theatrics.

Founder signal

Operators with real insight into the problem they’re solving — not just pitch polish.

Early conviction

Teams building with urgency and clarity before external validation arrives.

Relationship-first mindset

Founders who want partners, not just capital.

Customer proximity

Teams that can learn directly from users and iterate quickly.

Securities disclosure

This page describes the criteria West Peek Ventures applies when evaluating founders. It does not represent an offer or solicitation to buy or sell securities, and nothing on it is a recommendation to buy or sell any security. Such an offer must be made via definitive legal documentation by the seller of securities.

Potential buyers or sellers of securities should seek professional counsel prior to entering into any transaction. Read the full disclosures.
